notes: Articles appear when the sentence is very short and rehearsed, but disappear as soon as the noun phrase grows ("was project architecture meeting").
Self-corrects after repetition: repeated the same sentence two or three times before producing "she enjoyed a joke one night".
Writes 'an' but says it like 'a' — the vowel-linking in an email / an idea / an action plan needs slow, repeated speaking practice.
Work vocabulary (meeting, report, action plan) is already familiar, so daily-life prompts can borrow those nouns without raising the difficulty.
